transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

I... um, I guess I'm just struggling lately. I've been feeling... really bad about myself. Like I'm just a disappointment. I had a... a near-miss at work recently, and it just... I can't stop thinking that maybe I'm a danger to the patients. That maybe I'm just not cut out to be a nurse at all. Sometimes I think everyone would just be better off if I wasn't around.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things anymore that used to bring you pleasure, like hobbies or spending time with friends or family?

Yeah... I guess so. I used to do things to clear my head after class. Um... like jogging, or reading. Sometimes knitting or cooking. But now... I don't know. I usually just end up sitting on my bed in my scrubs. I just... can't really make myself care about any of it.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy most days, even when you haven't done anything physically or mentally demanding?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, my shifts are pretty tiring anyway, so... I haven't really noticed feeling tired for no reason. Just the normal amount, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's... it's been hard to sleep. I just lie there for a long time. I can't really stop replaying charts in my head... or going over medication calculations. And... when I finally do fall asleep, I usually wake up way before my alarm. I just... I wake up already exhausted. And kind of... scared that I missed something.
Have you been feeling like you're a burden to others or that you're not worthy of care or support?

Um... yeah. I guess so. That's... kind of why I'm here, actually. 

I just... there was this near-miss at work recently. And... I don't know, I can't stop feeling like I'm a danger to people now. Like I'm just a disappointment. It really feels like... like it just proves I'm not meant to be a nurse at all. Sometimes I just think... everyone would be better off without me.
Have you had any thoughts about ending your life or wishing you weren't alive?

Um... I don't... I don't have a plan or anything to hurt myself. But... I don't know, sometimes I just think... it would be easier if I didn't wake up. Or... if I could just disappear. Then I wouldn't... I wouldn't be able to mess anything up again.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these thoughts and feelings been pretty constant, or are they a recent change for you?

Um... it's been a while, I guess. Maybe... maybe about a year and two months? It kind of started right after high school... when I started taking college classes and working full-time at the clinic. It's just... been like this since then.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down or hopeless, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
Um... I don't really remember feeling quite like this before. I mean, I've had bad days, but... this is the first time it's been... like this.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for a couple of weeks or more?
No... not that I can remember. Just... just this time.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident, to the point where it was out of character for you?
No... I don't think so. I've never really felt like that.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for a week or more?
Um... no. Like I said... it's really just been this time. I haven't felt like this before.
Have your feelings of sadness, low self-worth, and loss of interest been present almost every day for at least the past two years?
No... not two years. Um, maybe like... a year and two months? It just sort of started after I graduated high school... when I started my college classes and working full-time at the clinic.
Have your feelings of sadness, low self-worth, and loss of interest been present almost every day for at least two years, or have there been times when you felt better for a while in between?
I... I don't know. I just... I haven't been feeling well for a little over a year. I don't really remember if there were good days in between. It's just... been hard.
Have there been times during this past year when your mood improved for a few days or more, where you felt like your usual self again, even if just briefly?
Um... not really. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling... like my usual self. It just all kind of blends together.
